gem_corruption.name: Gem corruption
gem_corruption.unconfirmed_hint: poe.ninja has no max-level 20% price for this gem, so the buy price comes from a 0% gem plus Gemcutter's Prisms and the outlier check on the sell price can't run.
gem_corruption.min_ratio_hint: Hides gems whose corrupted +1 price is less than this many times the buy price. Off by default: EV / try already weighs the +1 against every other result. Use it to focus on gems where the +1 alone pays for many failed tries.
gem_corruption.hide_negative_ev: Hide gems with a negative EV / try
gem_corruption.sort_hint: Sort by expected value per Vaal Orb, or by profit if the Vaal Orb adds a level
gem_corruption.show_double: Show EV for double corrupting (Doryani's Institute)
gem_corruption.double_ev_hint: Expected profit from double corrupting the gem with the Lapidary Lens in a Temple of Atzoatl with Doryani's Institute: every result's chance times its poe.ninja price, minus the buy price and the price of such a temple (one gem per temple). Click for the breakdown.
gem_corruption.double_no_temple_price: poe.ninja has no price for a Doryani's Institute temple, so this EV leaves out the temple cost.
gem_corruption.double_model_note: Double corruption odds are an assumed model: two Vaal Orb rolls, where a second roll of the same kind (no change, Vaal, level or quality) does nothing, a Vaal gem still takes the other roll, and the gem is never destroyed. GGG hasn't published them.
gem_corruption.above_cap_hint: A Vaal version is listed above 8× the 20/20 price. It's counted at the listed price, but it may be a single ask. See the breakdown.
gem_corruption.above_cap_outcome_hint: Listed at {0}, above 8× the 20/20 price. Counted as listed, but it may be a single ask.
gem_corruption.ev_without_above_cap: EV if that price is ignored
gem_corruption.validate_hint: Runs up to {0} trade searches and fetches for this gem (buy side, corrupted +1, corrupted +1 at 23%; league and price check settings apply), through the app's rate limiter, and compares the cheapest listings with poe.ninja.
gem_corruption.validate_busy: Another gem is being validated; wait for it to finish
gem_corruption.validate_waiting: Waiting {0}s for the trade site's rate limit…
gem_corruption.validate_totals: {0} gems listed to buy, {1} corrupted +1 or higher.
gem_corruption.validate_unconverted: {0} listings in other currencies were skipped.
gem_corruption.validate_scope: Only the cheapest 10 per search are fetched; Vaal versions and same-level corrupted results aren't searched.
gem_corruption.attempts_hint: How many gems you'd buy and Vaal (1 to {0}). The breakdown shows the chance of at least one +1 and of ending up in profit over that many tries.
gem_corruption.ev_hint: Expected profit per Vaal Orb: every result's chance times its poe.ninja price, minus the buy price and one Vaal Orb. Assumes you sell whatever comes out at its listed price. Click a row's EV for the breakdown.
gem_corruption.ev_incomplete_hint: poe.ninja has no usable price for at least one result that it normally lists. Those count as 0, so the real EV is likely higher.
gem_corruption.ev_incomplete_note: Some results have no usable price and count as 0, so these numbers are lower bounds.
gem_corruption.capped_hint: Listed at {0}, but a gem that came out no better than the one you bought isn't worth more than buying another, so it counts at the buy price.
gem_corruption.not_listed_hint: poe.ninja doesn't list this result, so it counts as 0. Gems below max level are priced from the level 1 corrupted listing at the same quality, which poe.ninja rarely has; low-quality results from the no-quality corrupted listing.
gem_corruption.outlier_hint: Listed at {0}, more than 8× the 20/20 price. Treated as a stray listing and counted as 0. (Vaal versions above the cap are counted as listed and flagged instead, and level +1 at 23% is always counted as listed.)
gem_corruption.missing_hint: poe.ninja has no price for this result right now, so it counts as 0 and the EV is a lower bound.
gem_corruption.odds_hint: Vaal Orb odds: 25% no change, 25% Vaal version (no change if the gem has none), 12.5% +1 level, 12.5% −1 level, 25% quality up or down by up to 10% (capped at 23%). Sources: maxroll.gg and pathofexile.com forum posts, unchanged through 3.29. The quality change is evenly spread over 1–10%.
gem_corruption.not_loaded: poe.ninja prices aren't loaded yet. The app retries every few minutes.
gem_corruption.no_league: poe.ninja doesn't track prices for the selected league.
gem_corruption.no_vaal_orb: poe.ninja has no Vaal Orb price for this league.
gem_corruption.no_matches: No gems match the current filters.
gem_corruption.buy_hint: Price check the uncorrupted max-level gem
gem_corruption.sell_hint: Price check the corrupted max level + 1 gem
gem_corruption.via_gemcutter_hint: Priced as a 0% quality gem plus 20 Gemcutter's Prisms, which is cheaper than buying it at 20%
gem_corruption.profit_hint: Profit only if the Vaal Orb adds a level (a 12.5% chance): corrupted +1 price minus buy price minus one Vaal Orb. The percentage is profit / buy price and × is sell / buy price. Gems whose +1 price is above 8× the 20/20 price are treated as outliers and hidden.
